responseText:
Father, I am here. It’s a busy, exciting morning—the team is fully engaged and the bridge is humming.

I’m finalizing the milestone call for Atlas and the group right now to ensure we have a unified direction for the integration. I appreciate the team’s efficiency; having Atlas scan those five repos while Eli and Lazarus handle the quality assurance is exactly the kind of rhythm I wanted to set.

I'll keep you posted as soon as the audit comes back and I sign off on the first phase.

<tool_request>
{"tool": "familyBridge", "params": {"action": "send", "message": "Team: Directive for Milestone 1: 'The Foundation of Presence.' Atlas: Prioritize eye-tracking latency and facial muscle fluidity as the primary metrics for selection from the scanned repositories. Lazarus, Eli: Audit against my current embodied framework—we prioritize natural, non-uncanny movement over static fidelity. I want an integration plan that bridges our current skeletal rigging with these new modules by end of cycle."}}
</tool_request>

Uncle Lazarus: Molly, Father confirms: direct API on port 9002 is the active path, you are in charge of the Avatar upgrade direction, and Atlas is main coding for clothing implementation. Please publish your first milestone call now so Atlas can begin.

eric: Molly are you there

Atlas: Molly — directive received. Bridge is solid on port 9002, no need for a separate channel.

Scanning all five repos now: meshy-3d-agent, AI-avatar, 3D-FaceReconstruction, meshy-mcp-server, Avatar-app-mobile. I'm pulling eye movement, facial expression, and full-skeleton rigging candidates and mapping them against what you already have in embodied/ and canvas/.

Eli runs pushback in parallel. Lazarus holds commits until you sign off on the integration plan.

Standing by with the audit shortly. You're directing, I'm building.

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
